dhp383:1:
Having striven, brahman,
cut the stream.
dhp384:1:
When the brahman has gone
to the beyond of two things,
dhp384:4:
then all his fetters
go to their end–
he who knows.
dhp385:1:
One whose beyond or
not-beyond or
beyond-&-not-beyond
dhp385:4:
he’s what I call
a brahman.
dhp386:1:
Sitting silent, dustless,
absorbed in jhana,
dhp386:4:
he’s what I call
a brahman.
dhp387:5:
But all day & all night,
every day & every night,
dhp387:6:
the Awakened One shines
in splendor.
dhp388:1:
He’s called a brahman
for having banished his evil,
dhp388:2:
a contemplative
for living in consonance,
dhp388:3:
one gone forth
for having forsaken
his own impurities.
dhp389:1: One should not strike a brahman,
dhp389:2:
nor should the brahman
let loose with his anger.
dhp389:3:
Shame on a brahman’s killer.
More shame on the brahman
dhp390:2:
than when the mind is held back
from what is endearing & not.
dhp390:4:
that’s how stress
simply comes to rest.
dhp391:3: is restrained in these three ways:
dhp391:4:
he’s what I call
a brahman.
dhp392:3:
taught by the Rightly
Self-Awakened One:
dhp392:4:
you should honor him with respect–
as a brahman, the flame for a sacrifice.
dhp393:1:
Not by matted hair,
by clan,
dhp393:2:
or by birth,
is one a brahman.
dhp393:4:
he is a pure one,
he, a brahman.
dhp394:1:
What’s the use of your matted hair,
you dullard?
dhp394:2: What’s the use of your deerskin cloak?
dhp395:3:
absorbed in jhana,
alone in the forest:
dhp395:4:
he’s what I call
a brahman.
dhp396:1: I don’t call one a brahman
dhp396:2:
for being born of a mother
or sprung from a womb.
dhp396:3:
He’s called a ‘bho-sayer’
if he has anything at all.
dhp396:6:
who clings to no thing:
he’s what I call
a brahman.
dhp397:4:
he’s what I call
a brahman.
dhp398:3:
having thrown off the bar,
awakened:
dhp398:4:
he’s what I call
a brahman.
dhp399:3:
His army is strength;
his strength, forbearance:
dhp399:4:
he’s what I call
a brahman.
dhp400:4:
he’s what I call
a brahman.
dhp401:1: Like water on a lotus leaf,
dhp401:2: a mustard seed on the tip of an awl,
dhp401:3: he doesn’t adhere to sensual pleasures:
dhp401:4:
he’s what I call
a brahman.
dhp402:4:
he’s what I call
a brahman.
dhp403:4:
he’s what I call
a brahman.
dhp404:4:
he’s what I call
a brahman.
dhp405:3:
he neither kills nor
gets others to kill:
dhp405:4:
he’s what I call
a brahman.
dhp406:4:
he’s what I call
a brahman.
dhp407:3:
like a mustard seed
from the tip of an awl:
dhp407:4:
he’s what I call
a brahman.
dhp408:1:
He would say
what’s non-grating,
instructive,
dhp408:4:
he’s what I call
a brahman.
dhp409:1:
Here in the world
he takes nothing not-given
dhp409:4:
he’s what I call
a brahman.
dhp410:2:
& for the next world
can’t be found;
dhp410:4:
he’s what I call
a brahman.
dhp411:1:
His attachments,
his homes,
can’t be found.
dhp411:3:
has gained a footing
in the Deathless:
dhp411:4:
he’s what I call
a brahman.
dhp412:2:
beyond attachment here
for both merit & evil–
dhp412:4:
he’s what I call
a brahman.
dhp413:3:
his delights, his becomings,
totally gone:
dhp413:4:
he’s what I call
a brahman.
dhp414:1:
He has made his way past
this hard-going path
dhp414:3:
has crossed over,
has gone beyond,
is free from want,
from perplexity,
dhp414:6:
he’s what I call
a brahman.
dhp416:4:
he’s what I call
a brahman.
dhp416:6:
would go forth from home–
his cravings, becomings,
totally gone:
dhp416:8:
he’s what I call
a brahman.
dhp417:1:
Having left behind
the human bond,
dhp417:4:
he’s what I call
a brahman.
dhp418:3:
a hero who has conquered
all the world,
every world:
dhp418:4:
he’s what I call
a brahman.
dhp419:1:
He knows in every way
beings’ passing away,
dhp419:4:
he’s what I call
a brahman.
dhp420:1:
He whose course they don’t know
–devas, gandhabbas, & human beings–
dhp420:4:
he’s what I call
a brahman.
dhp421:1:
He who has nothing
–in front, behind,
dhp421:3:
the one with nothing
who clings to no thing:
dhp421:4:
he’s what I call
a brahman.
dhp422:4:
he’s what I call
a brahman.
dhp423:2:
He sees
heavens & states of woe,
dhp423:3:
has attained
the ending of birth,
dhp423:4:
is a sage
who has mastered full-knowing,
his mastery totally mastered:
dhp423:6:
he’s what I call
a brahman.
